description: Add a role the project is looking for (the Studio's Roles tab): the role name, how many people, what it involves and the pay (paid with an amount, currency and per day / flat / per hour; expenses only; unpaid; deferred / profit share). Up to 20 roles per project. Returns the project with its roles and their ids.

count_needed.description: How many people are needed for this role; default 1.

description.description: What the role involves; null clears it.

pay_amount_cents.description: The pay in the currency's minor unit (cents): 15000 with USD = $150. Paid roles only.

pay_currency.description: ISO currency code for a paid role, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP.

pay_type.description: paid (needs amount, currency and unit), expenses (expenses only), unpaid, or deferred (deferred / profit share).

pay_unit.description: What the amount covers for a paid role: day, flat or hour.

project_id.description: The project's id (from list_projects or create_project).

role.description: The role, e.g. Director of photography, Gaffer, Editor (the department is derived from it).

name: add_project_role
title: Add a role
